schema.note: maturity_rank is null for every non-assessed status. A blank rank is not a zero and must never be coerced to one.

strengths: Merges to the two sampled repositories require a passing check and a non-author review
The requirement is enforced by platform configuration, not convention
gaps: Repository population was never enumerated, so coverage is a sample statement
cells.rationale: A configuration export and a 22-merge sample agree, and an interview describes the same practice. Repeatable across the window sampled.
next_steps: Re-sample after the inventory to state coverage for the group
cells.scope_limit: Two ESS repositories over one quarter.

strengths: A dependency-scanning stage is defined in the sampled pipeline
gaps: No record was observed of how scanner findings are triaged or closed
No owner is named for the queue
cells.rationale: The stage exists and can be produced on request. Nothing supplied shows findings being worked, which is what separates a defined practice from a practised one.
next_steps: Supply six months of scanner findings with their disposition
Name the owner of the triage queue
cells.scope_limit: Pipeline definition only; no triage records reviewed.

strengths: All nine production deployments in the sampled month carry a change reference, an approver and a rollback note
The one rolled-back change carries the same record as the successful ones
gaps: The window contains no emergency change, so the exception path is untested
cells.rationale: A complete month of records for one application, consistent across every row including the rollback.
next_steps: Extend the sample across a window containing an emergency change

gaps: Assisted coding tools are in individual use with no group-level guidance
No owner is named for guidance on reviewing generated code
cells.rationale: Participants describe what they personally do and the descriptions do not agree. No written guidance was produced on request.
next_steps: Decide and write down how generated code is reviewed before it reaches a production branch, and name the owner of that guidance
cells.scope_limit: Two interview statements; no policy or usage record reviewed.

strengths: A documented intake-to-release path exists and the one traced change followed it
gaps: Review sign-off was recorded after deployment rather than before
A single traced change cannot establish whether that ordering is typical
cells.rationale: One real instance of the practice, with records that are not the procedure document itself. Whether it repeats is not established.
next_steps: Trace five further RIS changes, including at least one urgent change

strengths: A published standard requires an annual privileged-access review
gaps: No completed review record was observed for any in-scope system
The standard names no system of record in which outcomes are retained
cells.rationale: The standard exists and can be produced. Nothing supplied shows a review being carried out, and absence of a record in the material supplied is not evidence the review did not happen.
next_steps: Establish where completed reviews are retained and make that part of the standard
Provide the most recent completed review for two systems

cells.scope_limit: This group's in-scope systems are vendor-hosted and the group does not perform deployments. Nothing is missing; the practice does not apply to how it operates.
No session was held and no evidence of any kind was supplied. This is a statement about the evidence collected, not about the group.
cells.follow_up_question: Schedule the AI-readiness session with RIS, or record the cell as out of scope by agreement.

strengths: Connector changes are developed in version control with peer review recorded
gaps: Configuration changes made directly in the vendor console are outside version control
cells.rationale: Every merge in the quarter carries an approving review, over a documented population of one repository.
next_steps: Establish how direct console configuration changes are reviewed
cells.scope_limit: One connector repository over one quarter.

strengths: All 14 accounts in the enumerated privileged population had a second factor at capture time
The query definition and its completeness basis are both recorded
gaps: The enumeration is a point in time and the population may change
cells.rationale: An authoritative bounded query whose completeness is itself documented, corroborated by the platform policy export. The strongest evidence in this engagement.
next_steps: Re-run the enumeration at engagement close to confirm the population is unchanged

strengths: A memo places deployment access under the identity platform's privileged review
gaps: Interviews and the change export disagree: 3 of 14 emergency changes carry no linked record
The conflict is unresolved and the evidence cannot distinguish an incomplete export from an undocumented exception path
cells.rationale: The intended practice is stated and recognised. The records contradict it for emergency changes, so nothing here shows the practice running.
next_steps: Identify the system of record for emergency identity changes and confirm whether the supplied export is complete for that path - investigate before changing the process

cells.scope_limit: A session was held and a document search was run. Neither produced material that supports any level. This is not a low level; it is an absence of evidence.
cells.follow_up_question: Ask whether any AI use, planned or informal, exists in IAM and who would know.
